queries.name: automatic-mixing
queries.query: (all:"automatic mixing" OR all:"music mixing" OR all:"neural mixing") AND (cat:eess.AS OR cat:cs.SD)

queries.name: audio-effects
queries.query: (all:"audio effect" OR all:"audio effects") AND (all:neural OR all:learning OR all:differentiable OR all:representation)

queries.name: mastering
queries.query: all:"audio mastering" OR all:"automatic mastering" OR all:"neural mastering"

queries.name: differentiable-production
queries.query: all:"differentiable audio" AND (all:effect OR all:mixing OR all:production)

queries.name: spatial-production
queries.query: all:"spatial audio" AND (all:mixing OR all:production OR all:rendering)
